profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Uber
profile.summary:
I’ve been programming since I was 14. I started with Pascal, C, and C++, where I learned how computers work at a low level. I later spent 8 years in competitive programming (1 IOI, 2 ACM-ICPC World Finals) and earned a Computer Science degree.

Code Complete (2nd Edition) and The DevOps Handbook influenced how I think about software development.

Professionally, I’ve worked with C#, JavaScript, and TypeScript, focusing on using (and often getting rid of) abstractions to make complex systems simpler.

Currently building web infrastructure with TypeScript and React.

projects.title: Vendor Monitor
projects.description:
As a fullstack engineer:
- Refactored the web UI using React and Typescript. Moved from MobX to React Context. Created form infrastructure using React Hook Form. These changes significantly increased maintainability by replacing implicit state updates and procedural validation rules with explicit state transitions and a declarative form validation system based on Yup.
- Re-engineered component unit testing by following Jest and React Testing Library conventions. This allowed 100% coverage on all forms.
- Contributed to the company’s Design System React implementation. Reported 16 bugs and submitted 4 PRs to fix issues.
- Implemented deep linking between two web applications to facilitate user workflows.
- Implemented full-stack Role-based Access Control.

projects.title: Ureeka
projects.description:
A platform that provides business owners, access to the people, programs, and connections that will help bring their business to the next level.

Lead Engineer: 
- Maintained code quality standards focused on TypeScript and React conventions enforced by automated linting using ESLint and Prettier.
- Mentored team members.
- Discussed new features with the product team to find technical solutions to the business requirements.
- Interviewed candidates.

Frontend Engineer:
- Implemented video advertisement using Vimeo API.
- Refactored the design system library using Storybook.
- Migrated from manual deployments to automatic ones using GitLab CI.
